optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

professionalSummary.text: Senior evaluation engineer with two years of experience managing end-to-end evaluation programs for enterprise knowledge base models, including set maintenance, scoring, pre‑release testing, and release decision support.
professionalSummary.witness: "Maintained the evaluation sets of question‑answer pairs with source passages (around 1,900 items across four content domains) and the scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy."

experienceHighlights.text: Led pre‑release evaluation for five model versions, publishing detailed reports with per‑domain breakdowns to the model team and head of product.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Ran the pre‑release evaluation for each of the five model versions released in the year and published the report with per‑domain breakdowns to the model team and the head of product."

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated evaluation‑set changes with model and content teams during fortnightly quality reviews, ensuring clear responsibility boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Coordinated evaluation‑set changes with the model team and the content team in the fortnightly quality review; ship or hold decisions for each version were taken by the head of product on the basis of the report and the model team's recommendation."

experienceHighlights.text: Authored evaluation notes documenting set composition, known limitations (e.g., under‑sampling of new content domains), and hand‑over items for subsequent evaluations.
experienceHighlights.witness: "Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing set composition, the known limitation that newly added content domains were under‑sampled, and the hand‑over items for the next evaluation."

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Scoring script repository README and version 4.1 evaluation report, including verification trail of evaluation run identifiers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: "Work sample: the scoring script repository README and the evaluation report for version 4.1, with the evaluation run identifiers as a verification trail."

skills.text: Evaluation set maintenance, scoring script development, pre‑release testing, report generation, cross‑team coordination, documentation of assumptions and limitations.
skills.witness: "Responsibilities included evaluation‑set maintenance, scoring scripts, pre‑release evaluations and evaluation notes over about two years on the knowledge base quality team."
